family: F_N=family.evaluate on ALL actual N bits, exactly defined by family.py and proof.md. Its fixed public controller chooses the minimum accepted certificate dimension d_N; fallback outputs0 and sets d_N=N+1. The uniform verifier has W(N)=0 and V(x,w)=1 iff w is empty and evaluate(x)=1.
theorem: In the pinned full B2 model, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-8d_N+8 for EVERY integer N>=0. At EVERY sufficiently large integer length, d_N<=2^ceil(DZ), D=8818127579/2000000000, Z=ceil(L^(3/4))*ceil(B^(1/4)), L=ceil(log2 N), B=ceil(log2(L+1)). Also limsup log2(d_N)/Z<=Cstar6<=440906378851/100000000000, where Cstar6=inf_(S6)(w0+X) and S6 is explicitly defined in proof.md. For EVERY fixed real epsilon>0 there exists N_epsilon such that C_B2(F_N)>=4N-N^epsilon for EVERY integer N>=N_epsilon. The SAME eligible family has liminf C_B2(F_N)/N>=4.
